scripts.prebuild: npx tsx scripts/generate-capability-catalog.ts && npm run check:rate-card
scripts.secret:scan: test "$(gitleaks version)" = 8.18.4 && gitleaks detect --no-git --source . --config .gitleaks.toml --redact=100 --no-banner --verbose && find . -type f \( -name package-lock.json -o -name pnpm-lock.yaml \) -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -path '*/.git/*' -exec sh -c 'for lockfile do gitleaks detect --pipe --config .gitleaks.toml --redact=100 --no-banner < "$lockfile" || exit; done' sh {} +
